Remove one or more tool bindings from ocx.toml

Usage: ocx remove [OPTIONS] <IDENTIFIER>...

Arguments:
  <IDENTIFIER>...  Identifiers of the tools to remove (binding name or fully-qualified identifier, e.g. `cmake` or `ocx.sh/cmake:3.28`)

Options:
  -g, --group <NAME>  Target a specific group. Use `default` to target the implicit `[tools]` table, or a named group (e.g. `ci`) to target `[group.ci]`. Without this flag, all groups are searched; if the binding appears in more than one group an error is returned
  -h, --help          Print help
